corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, Depends, HTTPException, status
import polars as pl
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/logistics")

@router.post("/compare-shipping-rates")
async def compare_shipping_rates(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    content = await file.read()
    manifest_df = pl.read_csv(io.BytesIO(content))

    if not {"origin_zip", "dest_zip", "weight_kg", "carrier_agreement_id"}.issubset(manifest_df.columns):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, detail="Missing required manifest fields")

    # Scope negotiated rates strictly to agreements owned by current_user.tenant_id
    rates_df = pl.read_parquet("/storage/logistics/carrier_negotiated_rates.parquet").filter(
        pl.col("tenant_id") == current_user.tenant_id
    )
    merged_rates = manifest_df.join(rates_df, on="carrier_agreement_id", how="inner")

    return {
        "status": "computed",
        "quotes": merged_rates.select(["carrier_agreement_id", "carrier_name", "discount_percentage", "net_rate_usd"]).to_dicts()
    }
